title: Superbad (Excerpt)
description: Scene excerpts from Superbad (2007), screenplay by Seth Rogen & Evan Goldberg
author: Seth Rogen, Evan Goldberg

lines.lineText: Man, just - Evan, listen to me. You know Jules? You know what she just did? She came up to me and asked me if I would buy her alcohol. Not just her, her whole party. Do you know what that means? It means that by some miracle, we were paired up, we talked, and she actually thought of me afterwards. Thought of me enough to decide that I was the guy that she was going to trust the fun-ness of her party with. She wants me! She fucking wants my dick!
Did you ever think maybe she's just using you to get her alcohol?
Of course I thought of that! LISTEN TO THIS!
Yeah! My older brother always eats blue cheese. You know that stuff is actually moldy.

She has an older brother! She could have asked him, but she asked me! She looked me straight in the face and asked me. She wants to fuck me, man. Do you understand that? Fucking! Today is the day that fucking has become possible.
Are you stupid? You're not going to be able to sleep with her tonight.

She's going to be at the party, she's gonna be drunk, and she likes me at least a little, so I can get with her. Then, I make her my girlfriend, and then I fuck her all summer long! Then, by the time college rolls around, I'm the fuckin' fucking master, man!
Make her your girlfriend? Of course! That's good. So, hypnosis, love potion, or mind-control helmet?
Once I've gotten with her, I write her love letters, flowers, I'll do anything - I'll be the most pussy-whipped guy in the universe - what chick wouldn't go out with a guy like that?
What the hell, Evan?
Fuck you, man.
Fuck off, Greg. Why don't you piss your pants again?
That was, like, eight years ago, asshole!
(TO CLASSMATE) People don't forget! (TO EVAN) Wanna hear the best part?
Oh, I haven't?
Helen!

You do the same thing, man! Buy Helen her alcohol. Then, tonight, when you guys are both drunk, get with her! This is the last party we're ever going to go to as high school people! I've fully ignored my hatred for Helen in coming up with this, which is a big ass deal. We need to stop being pussy and for once just goes balls out, man!
I should get Helen alcohol?
Of course! It'll be pimp, and then you know she'll be drunk.
Have you talked to Fogell?
You talk to Helen, I'll find that retard Fogell.
Hey Helen! Hold up. Did you hear about the party tonight?
Yeah, I just heard. It sounds sweet. You're not coming, are you?
No, no, I am. That's why I came looking for you. Me and some guys are going to the liquor store after class, so I was thinking I could buy you yours, if you needed someone to.
Yeah! That'd be great, that'd save me such a hassle, cause I was going to beg my sister, but yeah, could you get me, like, a bottle of Goldschlager? I'll pay you back tonight.
You will absolutely not. It's my treat.
Wow. Thanks, Evan.
Hey! You punched my tit!
I'm sorry! Shit, shit. I'm so sorry! I just wanted to give you a friendly nudge in the arm, you know? I'm so sorry.
Don't worry about it. So I'll see you at the party?
Yeah. I'll see you then. I'm so sorry about that.
That douche bag isn't back yet, I've been standing here with my thumb up my ass.
I did it, dude. I even offered to pay for it. It was pimp.
Whoa. That is fucking pimp. Why didn't I do that? Shit.
That's what we get for trusting a mental midget! He's fucking it all up! I bet he pussied out, just like I said he would!

I mean, what are we going to tell the girls? "Sorry, we couldn't do what we promised because we're dickless incompetents!" We'll never get laid because of that little ass-fuck. How did he get in to State?! He's got shit for brains! Shit! How else can we get liquor?
Where have you been?
Yeah! You almost gave me a goddamn heart attack! You better fucking have it, where is it?
I got it. It's flawless! It's great, man, look.
Okay Mr..."McLovin"? What kind of a stupid name is that? What are you trying to be, an Irish R&B singer?
Well, they let you pick any name you want when you get there.
So you picked McLovin?
It was between that or Muhammad.
Why was it between that or Muhammad? Why didn't you just pick a common name?
Actually, Seth, Muhammad is the most commonly used name on earth.
Have you ever actually met a guy named Muhammad?
Have you actually ever met a guy named McLovin?
No! That's why you picked a bad name.
You probably have federal agents tracking you for even considering the name Muhammad on a fake ID!
Look at this shit man, you don't even have a first name. It just says "NAME: MCLOVIN"
One name?
I just thought McLovin sounded old, and the chicks would dig it.
Under what circumstances would you ever have to show a chick your ID?
She could ask. Or, I could just show it to her.
Holy shit! I don't believe this. This says you're fucking 25! Why didn't you just put 21?

I knew you would ask that. Look, every day, dozens of kids roll into the liquor store with fake ID's trying to act like Joe Casual. Each and every one of these kids just so happens to be 21 years old. Just how many 21 year-olds do you think there are?
Fool!

Calm down! It's not terrible! This might work, but it's up to you, Fogell. They'll either think, "Oh, it's another punk kid with a fake ID." Or, "Look, it's McLovin, the twenty five year-old organ donor". What's it gonna be?
I am McLovin.
You're not McLovin. No one's McLovin and this is never going to work. We need a new way to get alcohol. Could we drive to Canada or something?
I still think it's going to work.
What the fuck? Where's my car?
I told you, man! What did I say? I told you that was a dumb idea.
Why would you park in the staff-
Shut up, Fogell.
`Cause you're not staff.
I am aware of that, Fagell.
Will you still pick me up from work?
Let's go to your house.
